overview.description:
TreQ is a frontier computing company accelerating the path to useful quantum computing. We design, deploy and operate open-architecture quantum computing infrastructure that evolves as quantum technologies advance.


Our open-architecture quantum (OAQ) approach delivers computing infrastructure designed to incorporate complementary quantum technologies as they mature. Rather than betting on a single quantum computing technology, pioneering technical leaders can rapidly adopt new quantum capabilities, driving innovation across the computing stack while protecting long-term infrastructure investments.


TreQ delivers and operates systems at customer premises and shared computing facilities, providing a trusted foundation for organizations to build quantum capability today while continuously incorporating future advances.
